headline: Colby Out
caption:
Colby Covington is out of his RAF Abu Dhabi main event vs. Khamzat Chimaev, and Chris Weidman is stepping in.
Weidman or Chimaev? 👇

Covington pulled out with an undisclosed injury, per The National. Former UFC middleweight champ Weidman now wrestles Chimaev this Saturday, Nov. 14, at Etihad Arena.

🔥 Hot take: Weidman taking this on 5 days' notice is the bravest move of the year.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
question: Weidman or Chimaev?
hot_take: Weidman taking this on 5 days' notice is *brave*.
